title: Docking-Based Virtual Screening Identifies a Small-Molecule Inhibitor of the Translesion Synthesis REV7/REV3 Protein-Protein Interaction.
authors: Harrahill, Noah J; Patel, Seema M; Dash, Radha Charan; Zaino, Angela M; Gupta, Vihit; Geddes-Buehre, Dane H; Brereton, Colin; Rizzo, Alessandro A; Chatterjee, Nimrat; Korzhnev, Dmitry M; Hadden, M Kyle
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接虚拟筛选发现靶向REV7/REV3蛋白-蛋白相互作用的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及DNA损伤修复相关蛋白互作，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: REV7 is an adaptor protein that mediates protein-protein interactions (PPIs) in DNA damage response and cell cycle control. REV7 functions as a subunit of the translesion synthesis (TLS) DNA polymerase POLzeta, which is involved in the replicative bypass of DNA lesions. REV7 is also a component of the shieldin complex, which mediates the choice of pathway for DNA double-stranded break (DSB) repair. TLS promotes cancer cell survival after DNA damage and serves as a mechanism through which cancers develop acquired chemoresistance. DSB repair helps cancers mitigate DNA breaks induced by radiation; therefore, inhibition of REV7 PPIs has emerged as a therapeutic strategy. We performed a docking-based virtual screen to identify compounds predicted to disrupt PPIs between REV7 and the REV7-binding motifs (RBMs) found in the REV3 subunit of POLzeta (TLS) and the SHLD3 subunit of shieldin (DSB repair). Biochemical analysis of a promising hit compound and several analogues demonstrated the ability of this scaffold to disrupt the REV7/RBM(REV3) PPI. Several REV7 inhibitors sensitize human cancer cells to radiation treatment, identifying these compounds as a new class of TLS and DSB-repair targeted anticancer drugs with potential as adjuvant therapies to improve the efficacy of genotoxic cancer therapies.
abstract_zh: REV7是一种衔接蛋白，介导DNA损伤应答和细胞周期调控中的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）。REV7作为转译合成（TLS）DNA聚合酶POLzeta的亚基发挥作用，该聚合酶参与DNA损伤的复制性旁路。REV7也是shieldin复合物的组成部分，该复合物介导DNA双链断裂（DSB）修复途径的选择。TLS促进癌细胞在DNA损伤后的存活，并作为癌症获得性化疗耐药性发展的机制。DSB修复帮助癌细胞减轻辐射诱导的DNA断裂；因此，抑制REV7 PPIs已成为一种治疗策略。我们进行了基于对接的虚拟筛选，以识别预测能破坏REV7与POLzeta的REV3亚基（TLS）和shieldin的SHLD3亚基（DSB修复）中发现的REV7结合基序（RBMs）之间PPIs的化合物。对有前景的命中化合物及几种类似物的生化分析表明，该支架能够破坏REV7/RBM(REV3) PPI。几种REV7抑制剂使人类癌细胞对辐射治疗敏感，将这些化合物确定为一类新型的靶向TLS和DSB修复的抗癌药物，具有作为辅助疗法以提高基因毒性癌症疗法疗效的潜力。
